description: Fisher test on PS00018 single-hit false-discovery rate, nphp-2 isoform EF-hand check, InterPro retry, FDR figure
code:
import requests, re, json
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
SIO=pd.io.common.StringIO

df=pd.read_csv("provenance/ps00018_specificity_celegans_proteome.csv")
print("reloaded",len(df),"proteome entries")
one=df[df.n_PS00018==1]; multi=df[df.n_PS00018>=2]
tbl=np.array([[(~one.has_EF_profile).sum(), one.has_EF_profile.sum()],
              [(~multi.has_EF_profile).sum(), multi.has_EF_profile.sum()]])
OR,p=stats.fisher_exact(tbl)
print("\nFisher exact: single PS00018 hit vs >=2 hits, outcome = lacks EF-hand profile")
print("  table =",tbl.tolist(), f"  odds ratio {OR:.1f}, p = {p:.3g}")
k,nn=int((~one.has_EF_profile).sum()),len(one)
ci=stats.binomtest(k,nn).proportion_ci(confidence_level=0.95)
print(f"  single-hit FDR = {k}/{nn} = {100*k/nn:.1f}%  (95% CI {100*ci.low:.1f}-{100*ci.high:.1f}%)")
k2,n2=int((~multi.has_EF_profile).sum()),len(multi)
ci2=stats.binomtest(k2,n2).proportion_ci(confidence_level=0.95)
print(f"  multi-hit  FDR = {k2}/{n2} = {100*k2/n2:.1f}%  (95% CI {100*ci2.low:.1f}-{100*ci2.high:.1f}%)")

print("\n### Isoform check: all C. elegans nphp-2 entries")
r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
  params={"query":"(gene:nphp-2) AND (taxonomy_id:6239)","format":"tsv",
          "fields":"accession,id,length,protein_name,xref_prosite,xref_pfam","size":25},timeout=120)
iso=pd.read_csv(SIO(r.text),sep="\t")
print(iso[["Entry","Entry Name","Length"]].to_string(index=False))
blob=iso.astype(str).to_string()
print("  EF-hand signature anywhere across nphp-2 entries?",
      "YES" if re.search("PS50222|PF00036|PF13499|SM00054",blob) else "NO")
print("  IQ signature (PS50096/PF00612) anywhere?","YES" if re.search("PS50096|PF00612",blob) else "NO")

print("\n### InterPro API retry")
try:
    j=requests.get("https://www.ebi.ac.uk/interpro/api/entry/InterPro/protein/UniProt/Q9BPN3/?page_size=100",
                   headers={"Accept":"application/json","User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"},timeout=120).json()
    for res in j.get("results",[]):
        md=res["metadata"]; print(f'   {md["accession"]:12s} {str(md.get("name"))[:55]:55s} {md.get("type","")}')
except Exception as e:
    print("   InterPro API still unavailable:",repr(e))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.8))
ax=axes[0]
cats=["1 PS00018 hit\n(NPHP-2 class)","$\\geq$2 PS00018 hits"]
noef=[100*(~one.has_EF_profile).mean(),100*(~multi.has_EF_profile).mean()]
ax.bar(cats,noef,color=["#d94f4f","#5aa469"],width=0.55)
for i,v in enumerate(noef): ax.text(i,v+2,f"{v:.0f}%",ha="center",fontweight="bold")
ax.set_ylabel("% lacking any EF-hand profile or HMM"); ax.set_ylim(0,80)
ax.set_title(f"PS00018 pattern false-discovery rate\nC. elegans proteome n={len(df)}; OR={OR:.1f}, p={p:.1e}",fontsize=10)
ax=axes[1]
vc=df[df.n_PS00018>0].groupby(["n_PS00018","has_EF_profile"]).size().unstack(fill_value=0).reindex(columns=[False,True],fill_value=0)
idx=vc.index.astype(int)
ax.bar(idx,vc[False],color="#d94f4f",label="no EF-hand profile")
ax.bar(idx,vc[True],bottom=vc[False],color="#5aa469",label="EF-hand profile annotated")
ax.annotate("NPHP-2 (Q9BPN3)\nsits here",xy=(1,40),xytext=(2.6,48),fontsize=9,
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",lw=1.2))
ax.set_xlabel("PS00018 pattern hits per protein"); ax.set_ylabel("proteins")
ax.set_title("Real EF-hands come in pairs; isolated single hits are mostly spurious",fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.set_xticks(idx)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

pd.DataFrame({"class":["1 hit","2+ hits"],"n":[nn,n2],
              "n_lacking_EF_profile":[k,k2],"pct_lacking":[100*k/nn,100*k2/n2],
              "ci95_low":[100*ci.low,100*ci2.low],"ci95_high":[100*ci.high,100*ci2.high]}
            ).to_csv("provenance/ps00018_fdr_by_hitcount.csv",index=False)
print("\nwrote provenance/ps00018_fdr_by_hitcount.csv")
